title: Wal-yawmil-akhir – belief in the Last Day
intro: The fifth pillar of iman: “and I believe in the Last Day.”

learn.title: 📖 In the Qur’an
learn.html: Allah tells us that the trumpet will be blown and everyone in the heavens and on earth will die, except whom Allah wills; then it will be blown a second time, and suddenly they will all stand, looking on. <small>(Qur’an, Az-Zumar 39:68)</small>
The fifth pillar of iman is: wal-yawmil-aakhiri – and I believe in the Last Day.

Belief in the Last Day guides a person to do as many good deeds as possible, to earn Allah’s mercy and reward, and to stay away from bad deeds so as not to be punished in the next world. One proof of how important this pillar is: the Qur’an very often mentions belief in Allah together with belief in the Last Day.

learn.title: Dunya and akhirah
learn.html: Allah decided that a person first lives in this world – the dunya – and then moves to the next world – the akhirah. This world is passing: in it we are born, live and die. The next world is eternal: in it we will be brought back to life and live for ever. Everything that has a beginning has an end; only Allah is eternal.

learn.text: Before the Day of Judgement come:

items: the first blowing of the trumpet (Sur) by the angel Israfil
death and the destruction of this world – the end of the world
barzakh – the place where souls stay
Israfil’s second blowing of the trumpet, and the resurrection
the gathering at the place of the final judgement
each person receives the book in which their good and bad deeds are written

learn.html: On the Day of Judgement Allah will judge people for their good and bad deeds. Every person will stand alone before Allah to give account. A person’s deeds will be put on the scales: whose good deeds are heavier, Allah will reward with Jannah; whose bad deeds are heavier will be punished with Jahannam – unless Allah has mercy on them.

The time of the Last Day is fixed and only Allah knows when it will come. Before it come ten great signs. The Prophet (SAW) once found his companions talking about the end of the world and said it will not come until ten things happen (Ahmad):

items: a great thick smoke that will cover people
the Dajjal, who will bring great doubt and violence among people
a creature called Dabbat al-ard, which will speak to people and tell them who is a believer
the sun rising from the west
the coming down of ‘Isa (AS), son of Maryam
Ya’juj and Ma’juj spreading across the lands
three great sinkings of the earth – in the west, in the east and in Arabia
a fire from the direction of Aden that will drive people to the place of judgement

learn.title: 📖 In the Qur’an
learn.html: Allah reminds us that over us are noble guardian angels who write and know what we do; the righteous will be in bliss and the wicked in the Fire; and on that Day no soul will be able to help another – the command that Day belongs to Allah alone. (Qur’an, Al-Infitar 82:9–19)

learn.title: ⭐ Remember
learn.html: The Last Day is the day of perfect justice, when every deed a person did – good or bad – will be shown.

practice.title: What comes before the Judgement
practice.prompt: Put these in order, from first to last.
items: Israfil blows the trumpet the first time
Death and the end of this world
Barzakh – where souls stay
The second blowing and the resurrection
Everyone is gathered for the judgement
Each person receives their book of deeds

practice.title: The great signs
practice.prompt: Tap every great sign before the Last Day, then tap Check.

options.text: 🌅 The sun rising from the west
🌧️ A lot of rain in spring
options.why: Rain in spring is a normal blessing from Allah, not a sign of the Last Day.

questions.q: What is the fifth pillar of iman?
options: Wal-yawmil-aakhiri – belief in the Last Day

questions.q: Who knows when the Last Day will come?
options: Nobody can ever know anything about it

questions.q: How many great signs did the Prophet (SAW) mention?
What happens to a person whose good deeds are heavier?
options: They come back to the dunya

practice.title: Questions and tasks
prompts: 💬 What is the Last Day, and what comes before it?
📝 Find and write some of the small signs of the Last Day that the Prophet (SAW) mentioned.
📖 Find Surah Al-Qari‘ah in the Qur’an, read its meaning and write a few sentences about what it says.
